prompt: A town of exiled mages, every tower a different school of magic.

card.name: Enclave of the Exiled Mages

site.text: A town of towers on ordinary ground, sized to fit within the 64-block claim

style.text: Arcane and varied: each tower has its own palette and motifs matching its school of magic, tied together by a shared stone base and a sense of exile

purpose.text: A refuge and community for exiled mages, where each school of magic keeps its own tower

card.interpretation: I took this as a medium town built flat on ordinary ground inside your 64-block claim. Its character is a ring of distinct wizard towers, one per school of magic, around a shared conclave hall. The style is arcane and varied: each tower has its own palette and theme, and a common stone base unites them. Purpose is a home base for the exiles, with a library, an inn and modest dwellings. No backstory was given, so none is added.
assumptions: Seven schools: fire, water, death, enchantment, nature, alchemy, astral
Search for a suitable site since no location was named

program.notes: Where the exiled schools meet; round council chamber with a ring of seats and a floor sigil.
Evocation/fire school: red nether brick, blackstone, lava-lit braziers, open flame top.
Water school: prismarine, dark oak, glass, pools and drip channels.
Death school: deepslate, bone, soul lanterns, crypt cellar.
Enchanting school: purple and gold, bookshelves, enchanting tables, amethyst crown.
Nature school: moss, oak, vines, azalea, a tree growing through the middle.
Potion school: brewing stands, copper, cauldrons, green glass.
Divination/sky school: quartz, dark blue, glass dome, telescope and star charts.
Shared salvaged books and tomes from lost academies.
Modest homes for students and servants clustered around the towers.
Common gathering place for mages of rival schools.
